nodes.text_en: Is the LCD display on your remote control showing any text or icons?
nodes.text_hi: Kya remote ke screen (display) par koi text ya icon dikh raha hai?

options.label: Yes, remote screen is clear and active
No, remote screen is totally blank or faded

nodes.text_en: Did inserting a brand new pair of AAA alkaline batteries restore the remote display?
nodes.text_hi: Nayi AAA batteries daalne ke baad kya remote display chalu hua?

options.label: Yes, display turned on and AC works
Display turned on, but AC still does not respond
No, remote screen is still completely dead

nodes.text_en: Point the remote tip at your smartphone camera and press buttons. Do you see a flashing purplish/red light on the camera screen?
nodes.text_hi: Remote ko phone ke camera ke aage rakh kar button dabayein. Kya phone screen par pink/purple light chamakti dikhi?

options.label: Yes, camera sees purple flashing light (Remote transmits OK)
No light visible on camera screen

nodes.text_en: Does the AC beep or respond to any button on the indoor unit's manual emergency switch?
nodes.text_hi: Kya AC par manual power switch dabane se beep ki awaaz aati hai?

options.label: Yes, AC works via manual switch (IR receiver fault)
No response to manual switch either

diag_faulty_remote_hardware.probable_cause: Corroded Battery Terminals or Broken Remote PCB Crystal
parts: LG AC Universal / OEM Remote Control (AKB74955604)
diag_faulty_remote_hardware.rag_query: LG AC remote control replacement model UW-Q18WUZA
diag_faulty_remote_hardware.technician_note: Provide replacement OEM remote control to customer.

diag_faulty_remote_ir_led.probable_cause: Damaged IR Emitter LED or Remote Keypad Membrane
diag_faulty_remote_ir_led.rag_query: LG AC remote IR emitter test replacement

diag_indoor_display_ir_pcb.probable_cause: Indoor Display PCB IR Receiver Sensor (Photo-diode) Failure
parts: Indoor Display PCB Assembly (IR Receiver Board)
diag_indoor_display_ir_pcb.rag_query: LG AC indoor IR receiver board replacement
diag_indoor_display_ir_pcb.technician_note: Measure 5V supply and IR signal pin on display PCB while firing remote.
